verdict.rationale: The alerts docs say you define "who is notified, and how" and can "route issues to the correct system or team using notifications," which implies machine destinations. The marketing line "move beyond assistance to automated remediation" points the same way. However, no evidence names webhooks as a notification channel or shows alerts triggering remediation or agents; the agent-triggering example (Jira/GitHub issues starting a coding agent) belongs to vulnerability management, not alert notifications. missing for 10: explicit webhook notification destination docs, payload/templating details, documented alert-to-remediation or alert-to-agent workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
